title: #IUIC #Bishop #Nathanyel7 #IsraelUnitedInChrist
segments: Israel, united in Christ, stands as a
beacon of righteousness, devoted to
rebuilding our nation upon the
unshakable foundation of the Most High's
laws and commandments. We are pillars in
our communities, bound together in
unity, honoring God through strong
marriages, vibrant families, and
unwavering faith. Yet recently, a grave
injustice unfolds in France. Under the
authority of Pascal Ljast, IUIC has been
unjustly targeted, our congregation
forcibly dissolved, and our right to
worship stripped away. A decree has been
issued that criminalizes our assembly,
threatening to imprison our brothers and
sisters simply for serving the Lord.
This is not merely an attack on IUIC. It
is an attack on faith, on liberty, and
on the divine right to worship. Let this
atrocity not go unnoticed. Share this.
Speak out. Let the world see what is
being done to those who stand for truth.
